staff_webhooks.entry.description: The name of the screen of the webhooks that send the server's events to other services, in the list at /admin and as the title of its screen. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.loading.description: At /admin/webhooks while the webhooks are read. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.failed.description: At /admin/webhooks when the webhooks could not be read, before Try again. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.one.loading.description: At /admin/webhooks/{id} while the webhook is read. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.one.failed.description: At /admin/webhooks/{id} when the webhook could not be read, before Try again. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.missing.defaultMessage: Il n’y a aucun webhook à cette adresse. Il a peut-être été supprimé.
staff_webhooks.missing.description: At /admin/webhooks/{id} for an ID that names no webhook, before the link to all webhooks. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.all.description: The link to /admin/webhooks under the sentence that an address names no webhook. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.list.count.description: The heading of the list of webhooks at /admin/webhooks: how many there are. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.add.description: The button that opens the form of a new webhook, at the end of the webhooks' heading or under the sentence that there is none. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.empty.defaultMessage: Aucun webhook pour l’instant. Configurez-en un pour envoyer les événements du serveur à un autre service.
staff_webhooks.empty.description: In the list of webhooks while there is none, over Set up a webhook. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.row.events.description: A fact of a webhook in the list: how many kinds of events it receives. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.state.on.description: At the end of a webhook's row: it receives its events. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.state.off.description: At the end of a webhook's row: it receives nothing. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.state.failing.description: The state of a webhook in the list of webhooks while its deliveries keep failing; it is still on. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.state.server_off.description: The state of a webhook in the list of webhooks that the server turned off, after its deliveries kept failing or its address answered that it is gone. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.standing.failing.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# envoi a échoué} other {# envois ont échoué de suite}} depuis {since}
staff_webhooks.standing.failing.description: Where a webhook that is on stands, in its row: how many attempts failed in a row and since when (a date and time). Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.standing.failing_off.defaultMessage: Désactivé par le serveur : ses envois n’ont cessé d’échouer
staff_webhooks.standing.failing_off.description: Where a webhook stands, in its row, after the server turned it off for deliveries that failed for 72 hours and 20 attempts. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.standing.gone.defaultMessage: Désactivé par le serveur : son adresse a répondu qu’elle n’existe plus
staff_webhooks.standing.gone.description: Where a webhook stands, in its row, after the server turned it off because its address answered 410 Gone. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.new.description: The title of the form of a new webhook, at /admin/webhooks/new. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.create.description: The button of the submit bar of a new webhook's form. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.save.description: The button of the submit bar of a webhook's form. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.endpoint.description: The heading of the section of a webhook's address and description. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.url.description: The field of the URL a webhook posts its messages to, and the name of that fact on a webhook's page. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.url.rule.defaultMessage: Une adresse qui commence par https:// ou http://, sans nom d’utilisateur ni partie après #, de 2048 octets au plus.
staff_webhooks.url.rule.description: Under the address of a webhook: the rule its value follows, also when it was refused. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.description.description: The field of a webhook's description, optional. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.description.rule.defaultMessage: Écrivez jusqu’à {max} caractères sur une ligne.
staff_webhooks.description.rule.description: Under the description of a webhook when it is too long or has a control character. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.group.defaultMessage: {group, select, reports {Signalements} accounts {Comptes et inscriptions} domains {Autres serveurs} posts {Publications} emoji {Émojis personnalisés} errors {Erreurs} other {{group}}}
staff_webhooks.group.description: The heading of a group of events a webhook may receive, a checkbox each. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.event.defaultMessage: {event, select, report_created {Un signalement est déposé} report_resolved {Un signalement est résolu} report_reopened {Un signalement est rouvert} registration_pending {Une inscription attend une approbation} account_created {Un compte est créé} account_updated {Un compte local modifie son profil} moderation_action_created {Un compte est modéré} moderation_action_lifted {La modération d’un compte est levée} appeal_created {Une contestation est déposée} domain_moderation_action_created {Un serveur est modéré} domain_moderation_action_lifted {La modération d’un serveur est levée} status_created {Un compte local publie en public} custom_emoji_created {Un émoji personnalisé est ajouté} custom_emoji_updated {Un émoji personnalisé change} custom_emoji_deleted {Un émoji personnalisé est supprimé} error_group_created {Une nouvelle erreur se produit} error_group_regressed {Une erreur résolue se reproduit} webhook_test {Message de test} other {{event}}}
staff_webhooks.event.description: An event a webhook may receive, as a checkbox of its form and as a delivery's name in its history; webhook_test is the test message. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.events.none.description: Under the first event of a webhook's form when none is chosen. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.events.missing.defaultMessage: Vos rôles n’autorisent plus les événements qui demandent {names}. Annulez vos modifications à leur sujet et enregistrez de nouveau.
staff_webhooks.events.missing.description: Under the first event of a webhook's form when the server refused events whose permissions (a list) the reader no longer holds. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.save.refused.defaultMessage: Rien n’a été enregistré. Corrigez ce qui est signalé et enregistrez de nouveau.
staff_webhooks.save.refused.description: Beside Save when the server or the form refused a field of a webhook, which is marked under it. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.save.failed.defaultMessage: Rien n’a été enregistré. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
staff_webhooks.save.failed.description: Beside Save of a webhook's form when the save failed with no field named. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.save.forbidden.defaultMessage: Vos rôles ne vous le permettent plus. Rechargez la page pour voir ce que vous pouvez faire.
staff_webhooks.save.forbidden.description: Beside Save of a webhook's form when the server refused the reader (403). Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.secret.description: The heading of the section of a webhook's secret shown once, and the name of the value to copy. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.secret.once.defaultMessage: Il n’est affiché que maintenant. Copiez-le dans le service qui reçoit les messages : il s’en sert pour vérifier leurs signatures.
staff_webhooks.secret.once.description: Right over a webhook's secret shown once. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.secret.copy.description: The button that copies a webhook's secret shown once. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.secret.created.description: The title of the view that takes the form's place once a new webhook was set up, over its secret. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.secret.rotated.defaultMessage: Le webhook a un nouveau secret
staff_webhooks.secret.rotated.description: The title of the view that takes the place of the new-secret section once a new secret was made. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.secret.done.description: The button after a secret shown once, which leaves it: to the new webhook's page, or back to the webhook's page as it was. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.on.description: The title of a webhook's summary while it receives its events and its last delivery worked. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.on.about.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Il reçoit # type d’événement.} other {Il reçoit # types d’événements.}}
staff_webhooks.summary.on.about.description: Under On, the summary of a webhook that is on and works: how many kinds of events it receives. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.failing.description: The title of a webhook's summary while it is on and its last attempts failed. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.failing.about.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# tentative a échoué} other {# tentatives de suite ont échoué}} depuis {since}. Le serveur désactive le webhook après 20 échecs de suite sur 72 heures ou plus.
staff_webhooks.summary.failing.about.description: Under the title that a webhook's deliveries are failing: how many attempts, since when (a date and time), and when the server turns it off. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.off.description: The title of a webhook's summary after an administrator turned it off. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.off.about.defaultMessage: Il ne reçoit rien tant qu’il n’est pas réactivé. Ce qui se passe entre-temps n’est pas envoyé plus tard.
staff_webhooks.summary.off.about.description: Under the title that a webhook is off. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.failing_off.description: The title of a webhook's summary after the server turned it off for deliveries that kept failing. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.failing_off.about.defaultMessage: Ses envois ont échoué pendant 72 heures et 20 tentatives de suite. Réactivez-le quand son adresse fonctionne de nouveau.
staff_webhooks.summary.failing_off.about.description: Under the title that the server turned a webhook off for failing deliveries. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.gone.description: The title of a webhook's summary after the server turned it off because its address answered 410 Gone. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.summary.gone.about.defaultMessage: Son adresse a répondu qu’elle n’existe plus (410). Changez l’adresse, ou réactivez-le si elle fonctionne de nouveau.
staff_webhooks.summary.gone.about.description: Under the title that the server turned a webhook off because its address said it is gone. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.test.description: The button that sends a test message to a webhook that is on. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.test.sent.defaultMessage: Un message de test est en route. Il apparaît dans les envois.
staff_webhooks.test.sent.description: Beside Send a test once the server took the test message. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.test.failed.defaultMessage: Le test n’a pas été envoyé. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
staff_webhooks.test.failed.description: Beside Send a test when the server did not take it. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.turn_off.description: The button that turns a webhook off. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.turn_on.description: The button that turns a webhook on. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.turned_off.description: Beside the summary's buttons once a webhook was turned off. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.turned_on.description: Beside the summary's buttons once a webhook was turned on. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.switch.failed.defaultMessage: Rien n’a changé. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
staff_webhooks.switch.failed.description: Beside the summary's buttons when turning a webhook on or off failed. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.facts.description: The heading of the section of what a webhook is: its address and dates. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.facts.created.description: The name of the fact of when a webhook was set up, over the date and time. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.facts.revised.description: The name of the fact of when a webhook's address, description or events last changed, over the date and time. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.deliveries.description: The heading of the section of a webhook's deliveries of the last 14 days. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.deliveries.loading.description: In the section of a webhook's deliveries while they are read. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.deliveries.failed.description: In the section of a webhook's deliveries when they could not be read, before Try again. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.deliveries.empty.defaultMessage: Rien n’a été envoyé ces 14 derniers jours.
staff_webhooks.deliveries.empty.description: In the section of a webhook's deliveries while there is none. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.attempts.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {Pas encore envoyé} one {# tentative} other {# tentatives}}
staff_webhooks.delivery.attempts.description: A fact of a delivery: how many times it was sent. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.attempt.defaultMessage: {outcome, select, succeeded {Réponse {code}} http_error {Réponse {code}} timeout {Aucune réponse en 15 secondes} connection_error {Connexion impossible} forbidden_destination {Ce serveur n’est pas autorisé à se connecter à cette adresse} other {{outcome}}} à {at}
staff_webhooks.delivery.attempt.description: A fact of a delivery: what its last attempt got (an HTTP status code, or why it got none) and when (a date and time). Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.status.defaultMessage: {status, select, pending {En attente} succeeded {Remis} failing {En échec} other {{status}}}
staff_webhooks.delivery.status.description: At the end of a delivery's row: where it stands. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.redeliver.description: The button of a delivery that sends its message again. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.again.description: The last line of a delivery's row once the server took Send again. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.again_failed.defaultMessage: Il n’a pas été renvoyé. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
staff_webhooks.delivery.again_failed.description: The last line of a delivery's row when Send again failed. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.body.description: Over the body of the request a delivery sent (a JSON document), folded under its row until shown; also the name of the block that holds it. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.body_copy.defaultMessage: Copier ce qui a été envoyé
staff_webhooks.delivery.body_copy.description: The button under the body of the request a delivery sent, which copies it. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delivery.body_withheld.defaultMessage: Ce qui a été envoyé n’est montré qu’à une personne ayant la permission qu’exige son événement.
staff_webhooks.delivery.body_withheld.description: Under a delivery's row, in place of the body of its request, for a reader who lacks the permission its event needs (a report's: Handle reports). Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.rotate.description: The heading of the section of a webhook's page that makes a new secret. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.rotate.about.defaultMessage: Pendant 24 heures après la création d’un nouveau secret, l’ancien signe aussi les messages.
staff_webhooks.rotate.about.description: Under the heading of the section that makes a webhook's new secret. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.rotate.press.description: The button that makes a webhook's new secret, and the confirmation of its question. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.rotate.title.description: The question before making a webhook's new secret. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.rotate.text.defaultMessage: Le nouveau secret n’est affiché qu’une fois. Après 24 heures, lui seul signe les messages : mettez à jour le service récepteur avant.
staff_webhooks.rotate.text.description: Under the question before making a webhook's new secret. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.rotate.cancel.description: The button that closes the question before making a new secret, keeping the current one. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.rotate.failed.defaultMessage: Aucun nouveau secret n’a été créé. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
staff_webhooks.rotate.failed.description: In the section that makes a webhook's new secret when it failed. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delete.description: The heading of the last section of a webhook's page, apart, which deletes it. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delete.about.defaultMessage: Il ne reçoit plus rien, et ses envois ne sont plus listés.
staff_webhooks.delete.about.description: Under the heading of the section that deletes a webhook. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delete.press.description: The button that deletes a webhook, and the confirmation of its question. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delete.title.description: The question before deleting a webhook, named by its address's host. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delete.text.defaultMessage: Le webhook et ses envois sont supprimés définitivement. Saisissez son hôte pour le supprimer.
staff_webhooks.delete.text.description: Under the question before deleting a webhook, over the field of its host to type. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delete.cancel.description: The button that closes the question before deleting a webhook, keeping it. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.delete.failed.defaultMessage: Le webhook n’a pas été supprimé. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.
staff_webhooks.delete.failed.description: In the section that deletes a webhook when the deletion failed. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.irreversible.description: The mark beside the button that deletes a webhook. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.locked.events.description: On the page of a webhook the reader cannot change, the name over the list of the events it receives. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.locked.defaultMessage: Il reçoit des événements que vos rôles ne vous permettent pas de modifier : seule une personne autorisée à tous les gérer peut le modifier. Vous pouvez toujours le tester, le désactiver et le réactiver, lui donner un nouveau secret ou le supprimer.
staff_webhooks.locked.description: On the page of a webhook that receives an event whose permission the reader lacks, in the place of its form: why it cannot be changed, and what the reader may still do. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.column.host.description: The heading of the column of the webhooks' hosts in the list of webhooks. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.column.events.description: The heading of the column of how many events each webhook receives, in the list of webhooks. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.column.state.description: The heading of the column of where a webhook or a delivery stands, in the list of webhooks and of deliveries. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.column.event.description: The heading of the column of the deliveries' events, in a webhook's deliveries. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.column.attempt.description: The heading of the column of a delivery's attempts and the last one's outcome, in a webhook's deliveries. Read by administrators.

staff_webhooks.column.redeliver.description: The heading of the column of the Send again buttons, in a webhook's deliveries. Read by administrators.
